description: This file implements the CyclicBuffer class, which provides a lock-free, thread-safe circular buffer with file-backed storage for inter-process communication. It includes functionalities such as read/write operations, reservation, locking for exclusive access, and alerting mechanisms. The implementation involves handling synchronization primitives for Windows and POSIX systems, buffer management, and internal state handling.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A thread-safe, file-backed circular buffer for inter-process data exchange, supporting locking, reading, writing, reservation, and alert mechanisms.

methods.name: bool Validate()
methods.description: Ensures the buffer and its control structures are loaded and valid, returning true if the buffer is ready for operations.

methods.name: void AdminLock()
methods.description: Locks the internal administrator mutex or semaphore to ensure exclusive access to buffer management operations.

methods.name: uint32_t SignalLock(const uint32_t waitTime)
methods.description: Waits for the buffer's condition signal with a specified timeout, used during locking for synchronization.

methods.name: void AdminUnlock()
methods.description: Releases the administrator lock or semaphore.

methods.name: void DataAvailable()
methods.description: Virtual method intended to notify when data becomes available; default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: void Reevaluate()
methods.description: Reassesses buffer state and notifies agents if needed based on the current buffer activity.

methods.name: void Alert()
methods.description: Sets an alert flag and reevaluates buffer state to notify waiting agents.

methods.name: uint32_t Read(uint8_t buffer[],const uint32_t length,bool partialRead)
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer into a provided user buffer, handling wrap-around cases and partial reads if specified.

methods.name: uint32_t Write(const uint8_t buffer[],const uint32_t length)
methods.description: Writes data from a user buffer into the cyclic buffer, managing space, wrap-around, and optional reservation handling.

methods.name: void AssureFreeSpace(uint32_t required)
methods.description: Ensures there is adequate free space in the buffer by potentially moving the tail to make room.

methods.name: uint32_t Reserve(const uint32_t length)
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for future writing, preventing concurrent reservations.

methods.name: uint32_t Lock(const bool dataPresent,const uint32_t waitTime)
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access, optionally waiting for data presence and honoring timeout.

methods.name: uint32_t Unlock()
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer, allowing other processes to access it.

methods.name: uint32_t Peek(uint8_t buffer[],const uint32_t length) const
methods.description: Provides a non-destructive read of available data without advancing the buffer pointers.

methods.name: uint32_t GetOverwriteSize(Cursor & cursor)
methods.description: Returns the size to overwrite in the buffer for the given cursor; default is the cursor's size.

methods.name: uint32_t GetReadSize(Cursor & cursor)
methods.description: Returns the size of data available for reading for the given cursor; default is the cursor's size.
